title: Bulb Switcher II
description: Find the number of unique states of n bulbs after m operations using 4 different buttons.
pseudocode:
1. if m == 0 return 1
2. if n == 1 return 2
3. if n == 2 and m == 1 return 3
4. if n == 2 or m == 1 return 4
5. if m == 2 return 7
6. return 8

steps.note: Check base case: no operations mean initial state only.
If only 1 bulb, operations toggle between ON and OFF.
For n=3, m=1, calculate possible states: all off, all on, flip even, flip odd.
For n >= 3 and m >= 3, all 8 combinations of operations are reachable.
